title: MIT ion plane credits obscure 1920s scientist

tellings.quote: MIT has demonstrated a plane with no moving parts, their ion plane.

plain: Jan Lundquist, a researcher speaking in a documentary on Jesse Michels's channel about the scientist Townsend Brown, says that in 2018 the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) showed a plane with no moving parts, flown by electrically charged air, which it called an ion plane. Lundquist says this work owes a debt to a little-known scientist from the 1920s, which would mean ideas long dismissed as fringe actually worked.
